cohort: 25,354 women who underwent a benign hysterectomy in Sweden between 2000 and 2014
finding: Previous cesarean delivery is associated with an increased risk of complications during a subsequent hysterectomy, including organ injury and postoperative infection, but only partly attributable to the presence of adhesions.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean delivery was a predictor of bladder injury and bowel injury during subsequent hysterectomy, but not ureter injury.
